The Wind from Washington

ᚈᚇᚈ Seanchan · 2026-11-12 · told by candlelight

A quiet evening of reading the news: the new Congress weighed, the diesel bargain measured, and the telling set down on the teller's own bench. Recorded as it happened; mossed by hand after.

firemandecko
what's the most likely thing trump gets impeached for in the new house and senate?
the agent

The forge was asked to read the wind from Washington: what charge the new Congress would most likely raise against the president. Nine days past the midterms had swept both chambers blue — the House by some forty seats, the Senate flipped in states that had not sent such a messenger in a lifetime — and the market candles priced the impeachment itself at about a coin toss.

The forge searched the open record and gave its reading: the war on Iran, waged without the leave of the House that alone holds the power of war, as the likely head of the charge, with the counting of self-enrichment — the crypto ventures and their billion-dollar harvest — bound beside it. The war is a quarrel over what the parchment means; the enrichment is written in the president's own ledger. Removal the forge named a far country: the Senate's two-thirds bar stands high, and the markets give it less than one chance in five.

firemandecko
What about the diesel deal with russia?
the agent

Then came the asking after the diesel bargain: fuel bought from a sanctioned land, waved through by decree though the statute of 2022 forbids the import and only the Congress may lift that ban. The forge read the record: not one barrel has landed. The tankers circle the coast, unwanted, for no buyer will touch what the law forbids, whatever the license says.

The forge judged the bargain the cleanest count of all: a law broken in the open, an adversary paid, no inquiry needed to prove it. Letters of preservation have already gone to the ports and the banks — the keepers of the records are gathering their papers for the new Congress.

That dressing is the pre-processing Odin asked for: the language aligned with the garden first, the telling already in the garden's own tongue.
